named_box: JAXA Smart Lander for Investigating Moon (SLIM)
host: JAXA H-IIA F47 / SLIM — not CLPS; flown 2024
lab_use: Do not size a night-store from SLIM waking. JAXA printed overnight was not in the design (越夜 not assumed). Three wakes are not Cataldo 354 h, not a Wh, and not Blue Ghost Mission 1’s 5 h after sunset. CADRE on IM-3 is a different box (daylight-only) and is absent here.

quotes.text: despite not being part of the original mission plan, the spacecraft was confirmed to survive three lunar nights and remained operational

quotes.text: The mission had not been expected to continue past dark. But to the delight of the team, SLIM did wake
